note: Said of himself: 'I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture'

'Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last,' (Rev 1:17). The verse does not name the speaker; 1:13-18 is the vision of One like the Son of Man, who says at 1:18 'The Living One. I was dead, and behold, now I am alive forever and ever'. Repeated at Rev 22:13.
Said of himself: 'I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies'
Said of himself: 'I, Jesus, have sent My angel to give you this testimony for the churches. I am the Root and the Offspring of David, the bright Morning Star'
Said of himself: 'I am the way, the truth, and the life'
The title is built on the word.
'I am the light of the world' (John 8:12).
'the root and the offspring of David' -- root is the vine's word, and the figure is botanical, though Revelation does not develop it.
